title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
abstract: arXiv:2610.26942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. translated_title: 修复，而非仅仅重采样：Lean 4 中有界的编译器引导修复
translated_abstract: 自动化定理证明器通常依赖语言模型进行采样，但像 Lean 这样的证明助手会以精确的错误信息拒绝每个失败的证明步骤——而纯采样方法会丢弃这些信息。为了克服这一问题，我们引入了一个有界的、在线的步骤级修复模块。我们的搜索在每个步骤采样 $K$ 个候选策略，并对失败的策略最多修复 $R$ 次。我们不是丢弃失败的策略，而是将编译器的错误信息输入到预训练的修复模型中，以原位修复被拒绝的各个步骤。这种方法在所有测试的候选预算（$K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$）下都将解题率提升至高于纯采样基线，实现了高达 32% 的相对提升，并在 LeanDojo 基准的 1,990 个定理子集上多解出了 82 个定理。修复并非没有代价：它以额外的运行时间换取可证明的定理。但这种权衡是可预测的：当采样受限时修复的收益最大；其回报是前置的
tldr: 提出 Lean 4 中一个有界的、在线的步骤级修复模块，利用编译器错误信息驱动预训练修复模型原位修复失败的证明步骤，在所有采样预算下均优于纯采样基线，相对提升高达 32% 并多解决 82 个定理。
en_tdlr: A bounded, online step-level repair module for Lean 4 that feeds compiler error messages to a pretrained repair model to fix failed proof steps in place, outperforming sampling-only baselines across all candidate budgets with up to 32% relative gain and 82 additional theorems solved.
